name: TickPick
description: TickPick (US resale ticket marketplace, all-in pricing): discover sports, concert, theater and comedy events by free text, performer, venue or location, and read event details with event-level listing statistics (count, min/max/average all-in per-ticket price) and daily/hourly price history from TickPick's own web API. Per-listing offers are not available (DataDome-protected).

tools.name: Categories
tools.description: Browse without a query: list leagues, teams, genres and shows and get performer slugs. Cached daily by the site.

options.name: group
options.about: Return only the group with this name (case-insensitive), for example Baseball or Concerts. not_found when no group matches.

response.about: TickPick's navigation tree (api.tickpick.com/1.0/performers/navigation/categories/v3): groups (Baseball, Basketball, Concerts, Theater, ...) with sections (MLB, NBA, ...), sub-sections and items, each item a performer or category link with the slug and url_category that performer_events takes. Optionally filtered to one group by name.

fields.name: slug
fields.about: Category slug of the 'See all' link; null when the group has none.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: After search, performer_events or venue_events returned an event_id, or when the user pastes a tickpick.com/buy-... URL.

options.name: event_id
options.about: TickPick event id, for example 7368513. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A tickpick.com event page URL, https://www.tickpick.com/buy-.../{event_id}/. Alternative to event_id.

response.about: One TickPick event by id or buy-page URL (api.tickpick.com/1.0/events/{id}/details): identity, status, venue-local and UTC start with the venue timezone, venue, performers, categories, the seating-chart configuration and price_stats (listing count and min/max/average all-in per-ticket price across current resale listings). Availability is a snapshot; per-listing offers are not available.

fields.name: event
fields.about: One TickPick event record (from /events/{id}/details, the venue worker or the performer page).

fields.name: seating_chart
fields.about: Seating-chart configuration when the site has one for this event; null otherwise.

event.name: Washington Nationals vs. New York Mets

tools.name: Event price history
tools.description: To see how the cheapest ticket and the listing count moved over time for an event_id from search, performer_events or venue_events.

response.about: Price history for one TickPick event: daily points (date, lowest and average all-in per-ticket price, listing count) from /events/{id}/pricing/historical plus the recent hourly lowest-price trend from /events/{id}/price-trends/preview. An unknown id is not_found (verified against the event details); a known event with no history yet returns empty series.

fields.name: date
fields.about: Day as published (ISO 8601 date-time at midnight, no offset).

tools.name: Nearby events
tools.description: Location-first discovery: 'what is happening in Chicago'. Pass latitude/longitude; add the TickPick market slug (dma, for example washington-dc-md or chicago-il) for venues and just-announced lists.

options.name: dma
options.about: TickPick market slug (designated market area), for example washington-dc-md, chicago-il, los-angeles-ca. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

options.name: limit
options.about: Maximum rows per list (sports, concerts, theater, comedy, just_announced, venues, events). The site returns 12-20 per list.

response.about: What is on near a point (api.tickpick.com/1.0/search/nearby): performers with upcoming events in the market grouped as sports, concerts, theater and comedy (with next_event_date), the market's top events with lowest all-in prices, and, when a dma market slug is given, just-announced performers and the market's venues.

fields.name: categories
fields.about: Index category labels; null when the endpoint does not return them (search/all).

fields.name: event_date_local
fields.about: Venue-local start, ISO 8601 without offset; the timezone is on the event detail.

fields.name: is_primary
fields.about: True when the row is a primary (organizer) event rather than resale.

fields.name: min_price
fields.about: Lowest all-in per-ticket price in the index; null when the index carries none.

tools.name: Performer events
tools.description: Events for a performer whose slug and url_category came from search (performers[]) or categories (items[]).

options.name: include_nearby
options.about: Also return the page's nearby_events (relative to the proxy exit location) and international_events lists.

options.name: limit
options.about: Maximum events returned from the page's embedded first page (the site embeds 20). Fewer events than total_count is reported as partial coverage.

options.name: performer_slug
options.about: Performer slug, for example washington-nationals. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

options.name: url
options.about: A tickpick.com performer page URL, https://www.tickpick.com/{url_category}/{slug}-tickets/. Alternative to performer_slug + url_category.

options.name: url_category
options.about: Performer page category segment, for example mlb, concerts, theater (search performers[].url_category). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

response.about: Upcoming events for one TickPick performer (team, artist, show) read from the performer page's embedded data (www.tickpick.com/{url_category}/{slug}-tickets/): the first page of events (20 observed) with venue, venue-local and UTC start, status and price_stats (listing count, min/max/average all-in per-ticket price), the site's total_count, and optionally the nearby and international event lists. Coverage is marked partial when total_count exceeds the returned events; the site pages the rest through a per-deploy server action that is not exposed here.

fields.name: event_date_local
fields.about: Venue-local start, ISO 8601 without offset (see timezone). TBD dates appear with a placeholder time such as 03:30:00.

fields.name: event_date_utc
fields.about: UTC start, ISO 8601 without offset.

fields.name: event_id
fields.about: Stable TickPick event id; the event and event_price_history input.

fields.name: event_type
fields.about: Top-level type as stated (SPORTS, CONCERTS, THEATER, ...).

fields.name: original_event_date
fields.about: Original venue-local date when the event was rescheduled or its time was set later.

fields.name: price_stats
fields.about: Event-level snapshot of the live resale listings as published by TickPick (stats/summary): the number of listings and the per-ticket all-in price range. Null when the site publishes no statistics for the event (observed on TBD / if-necessary playoff dates). This is not a per-listing offer.

fields.name: primary_marketplace
fields.about: Primary ticketing marketplace code as stated (e.g. TDC); null when absent.

fields.name: status
fields.about: Event status as the site states it ('Scheduled' observed; other values pass through unchanged).

fields.name: tags
fields.about: Site event tags (HotEvent, FeaturedEvent, ...); empty when none.

fields.name: timezone
fields.about: IANA timezone of the venue.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Event (buy) page on tickpick.com; the source URL.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to resolve a team, artist, show, venue or event name to TickPick identifiers. For a full event list use performer_events or venue_events; for one event use event.

options.name: limit
options.about: Maximum rows returned per list (events, performers, venues). The site itself returns at most 300 events.

options.name: query
options.about: Search text, for example 'new york mets' or 'hamilton'.

response.about: Free-text search of TickPick's index (api.tickpick.com/1.0/search/all): events with venue-local date, venue, city/state/country and the lowest all-in per-ticket price; performers with their slug and url_category (the performer_events input); venues with their slug (the venue_events input); the index's exact match and top hit. The site returns at most 300 events with no paging; limit trims each list client-side and site_cap_reached says when the 300 cap was hit.

fields.about: True when the row is a primary (organizer) event rather than resale.

fields.name: min_price
fields.about: Lowest all-in per-ticket price in the index; null when the index carries none.

tools.name: Venue events
tools.description: Everything at a venue whose slug came from search or an event's venue. Page with offset = next_offset until it is null.

options.name: offset
options.about: Start index; pass next_offset from the previous page.

options.name: url
options.about: A tickpick.com venue URL, https://www.tickpick.com/venues/{slug}/tickets/. Alternative to venue_slug.

options.name: venue_slug
options.about: Venue slug, for example nationals-park (from search venues[].slug or an event's venue.slug). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

response.about: Upcoming events at one TickPick venue (api.tickpick.com/1.0/workers/paginate/venues/{slug}/events), paged with limit/offset and total_count: full event records with venue-local and UTC start, performers, status and price_stats (listing count, min/max/average all-in per-ticket price; null for TBD dates without statistics), plus the venue record, recently announced events and nearby venues.
